prompt: While attending a workshop on Apache SSL configurations, Liam, a system administrator, learns about the challenges associated with using SSL in virtual hosting environments. Which of the following statements accurately describes a primary issue when using traditional SSL with name-based virtual hosting?
choices: SSL requires a separate IP address for each virtual host, making it incompatible with name-based virtual hosting.
SSL certificates cannot be used at all with virtual hosts of any kind.
Name-based virtual hosting requires a unique port for every SSL certificate.
SSL disables the Host header, so all virtual hosts share one certificate.
explanation: Traditional SSL, before the introduction of SNI, necessitated the use of a distinct IP address for each SSL certificate. As a result, it wasn't compatible with name-based virtual hosting, which allows multiple domain names to be hosted on a single IP address.
